edh-c-18 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 18124; tuning half or held-out opened by the owner for the top 20,000), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (fetched 2026-10-30) and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25) (eff.edhv18.you.skip.drawStep.thisTurn): At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle (eff.t17.search.may.revealThatCard.hand). If you do, you skip your draw step this turn: a replacement effect that skips the controller's draw step, lasting this turn (replace step draw of you, body skip, duration endOfTurn; CR 614.10, 504.1, 500.11). "If you do" means if you search (ruling 2004-10-04): accepting the may skips the step even when no land is found. Played: skipped after a search, not skipped when the may is declined, not skipped next turn, skipped with an empty search.
